title: European Commission launches RAISE pledging initiative for AI in science
excerpt: The initiative aims to mobilise private-sector and philanthropic support for European researchers working across artificial intelligence and science.
bodyHtml:
The European Commission launched the RAISE (Resource for AI Science in Europe) pledging initiative on October 15, 2026, at the European AI in Science Summit in Dublin. The initiative aims to mobilise private-sector and philanthropic support for European researchers working across artificial intelligence and science, beyond what public funding alone can provide.

Participating organisations must make a concrete pledge showing sustained support for AI in science beyond their direct commercial interests. Contributions may include financial support, access to computing infrastructure, AI models, datasets, cloud services, software licences, scholarships, fellowships, and training programmes. Initial commitments have been made by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, Nvidia, Elsevier, Sanofi, Frontiers, Mistral, and Google DeepMind. The initiative remains open to further contributions.

As part of the initiative, Mistral AI and CERN launched a new partnership to develop what is set to become the largest foundation model in physics. The initiative will be reviewed annually, with pledges and progress presented at future editions of the European AI in Science Summit.
